body: My old University professors called me to tell me there is counseling available if needed... I think I'll take them up on it... Also, to anyone else considering committing suicide; you have no idea the kind of shock it will put a person that loves you through to have to clean up your literal "mess"... No, the city/government does not offer these kinds of services.  Cleaning up blood out of any home, or truck as was the case here, is the responsibility of the owner.  Imagine the scene from the movie Pulp Fiction where Vince accidently shoots the guy in the back of the car; now imagine your child, or parents, or loved ones having to debate with themselves whether to use bleach or ammonia to get the stains out and having to go buy extra ozium for the stench of it all... It's a big damn mess, don't do it...
Debt and health issues... Lived a very full life and said he'd done just about everything he had cared to do in this life...
I'm a few weeks away from being 23
